description: Dr. Michelle Schreiner reflects on her Puerto Rican heritage, losing and reclaiming Spanish, family, motherhood, and what we choose to carry forward.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Michelle For Georgia House** Photography: Kevin Lowery and Tara Gulledge
title: The Heritage We Build — Michelle Schreiner is a candidate for Georgia House District 45, rooted in East Cobb and focused on steady leadership, practical solutions, and real progress for Georgia families.
